newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won ends down on dollar short-covering.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won ends down on dollar short-covering.

text.p: The won finished slightly lower versus the dollar on Wednesday as banks accumulated dollars to cover their short positions, traders said.
But dollar supply from export deals in the afternoon eased won's early losses, they said.
The won closed at 892.20 against Tuesday's closing of 892.00. It moved in a range of 892.10-893.30 after opening at 892.50.
Dealers expected the won to move in a range of 891.00 to 893.50 on Thursday with a base mid-rate at 892.60. Wednesday's mid-rate was pegged at 892.40. -- JEAN YOON (822) 727 5643
